exact_statement: The sign/indicator, logarithm, biased-influence and character conventions of A004-NORMALIZATION-LEDGER@1 remain in force. For every uniform-cube Boolean sign and physical coordinate i, f=psi+x_i*phi with ternary disjoint psi,phi, psi^2+phi^2=1, I_i=E phi^2 and coefficients fhat(T)=psihat(T), fhat(T+i)=phihat(T). Write a=psihat(T)^2,b=phihat(T)^2. Then B_i=sum Phi(a,b)=L_down,i+C_up,i, L_down,i=sum b log2(1+a/b), C_up,i=sum a log2(1+b/a)<=I_i/ln(2); B05 mismatch L_i is B_i, whereas A003 downward L_i is L_down,i. Delta_i=B_i+JS_i and h2(I_i)-B_i=MI(S_i;S_without_i). DTC=H-sum B_i, TC=sum h2(I_i)-H, and sum marginal slacks=TC+DTC. Uniform characters preserve full B,DTC but swap the two directional terms when the queried coordinate is translated. For any finite set law P with v=1-P_empty>0 and R=P conditioned nonempty, B(P)=vB(R)+T0 and DTC(P)=h2(v)+vDTC(R)-T0, where T0=sum Phi(P_empty,P_{i}). AND2 certifies that DTC(P)=vDTC(R) is false; point defects n>=2 have DTC(P_n)/(v_n DTC(R_n)) asymptotic to 2^n, although their FEI ratio tends to 4. No universal erasure or FEI payment is asserted.
